name: Web Usmender
description: USMender is a mobile-first repair messenger built around a local Matrix core. Users see USMender rooms, private drafts, mediator approvals, trust controls, and mobile clients while Matrix/Synapse stays local underneath as the durable room/event substrate.
short_desc: Mobile-first repair messenger wrapped around a local Matrix core with LLM/RAG mediation in the send path.
